## Detailed Practice Areas & Deliverables

### Practice 1: Digital Growth Engineering™ (DGE)
Digital Growth Engineering treats marketing and search visibility as an engineered discipline rather than disconnected ad-hoc tactics.
- **Market & Demand Analysis (Growth Intelligence™)**: High-precision intent modeling, keyword opportunity graphs, search landscape evaluation, and competitor reverse-engineering.
- **Digital Presence Architecture™**: Modern, lightning-fast web applications built on Next.js, React, and TailwindCSS. Entity verification, Google Knowledge Panel stabilization, and citation syndication.
- **Search & AI Visibility (SEO, AEO, GEO)**:
  - Technical SEO: Core Web Vitals, Schema.org JSON-LD graph architecture, crawl budget optimization, canonical management.
  - Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Structuring content for Google featured snippets, People Also Ask (PAA), and voice search.
  - Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Engineering content, entities, and citations for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, Claude, and Bing Copilot.
- **Paid Acquisition (Paid Growth Engineering™)**: Full-funnel performance marketing campaigns using Google AI Max, Meta Advantage+, LinkedIn B2B Account-Based Marketing, and programmatic media networks.
- **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**: Frictionless UI/UX flows, form abandonment mitigation, and data-backed A/B testing programs.
- **Revenue Intelligence**: GA4 server-side tag management, Meta Conversions API (CAPI), and multi-touch pipeline attribution modeling.

### Practice 2: Enterprise Solution Engineering™ (ESE)
Enterprise Solution Engineering builds scalable, automated digital operational architectures.
- **Digital Platforms & Portals**: Custom SaaS applications, partner portals, student portals, and enterprise design systems.
- **CRM Architecture & Modernization**: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Health Cloud deployments. Custom object modeling, workflow rules, and data hygiene.
- **Salesforce & Copado DevOps**: CI/CD automated release pipelines, sandbox management, automated testing, version control integration, and zero-downtime metadata migrations.
- **AI Systems & Autonomous Agents**: Enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, custom internal AI copilots, customer support agents, and document processing intelligence.
- **Workflow Automation**: Multi-step business process automation across Zapier, Make, n8n, and custom serverless microservices.
- **Connected Engagement™**: Unified omnichannel messaging layer spanning WhatsApp Business API, RCS messaging, SMS, and transactional email.

### Practice 3: Education Ecosystem Engineering™ (EEE)
Specialized practice dedicated to higher education institutions, universities, colleges, and training academies.
- **Accreditation & Ranking Advisory**: Preparation and audit frameworks for NAAC (A++ benchmarks), NBA, AICTE, UGC, and NIRF rankings.
- **Academic Ecosystems**: Outcome-Based Education (OBE) curriculum alignments, Board of Studies (BoS) corporate advisory, and faculty development.
- **Industry-Academia Integration**: Structuring corporate MoUs, establishing co-branded Centers of Excellence (CoE), and live industry hackathons.
- **Placement Cell Modernization**: Employability skill assessments, recruiter outreach engines, placement tracking portals, and corporate relations management.
- **Admissions Funnel Engineering**: Digital outreach campaigns, lead scoring engines, automated WhatsApp/SMS counseling journeys, and conversion architecture.

ISD Info Solutions is an enterprise digital growth and technology agency accessible at isdinfosolutions.com. The firm engineers web platforms, search & AI discoverability, custom AI platforms, and cloud infrastructure.
